name: Dependence
source:
――Makoto Osaka.
He is a normal and healthy second-year boy.
But, he may not be "normal" or "healthy" anymore.
He was "normal" at least a month ago until the day of the opening ceremony.
When he met him, he wasn't normal anymore.
He couldn't leave him as normal, so he's not mad.
It's all because of him --- Naomi Hidaka.

[From [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5799]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
——逢坂真琴。
他是一个普通而健全的初二男生。
但如今，或许已经不能再用“普通”或“健全”来形容他了。
至少在一个月前，在开学典礼那天之前，他还是“普通”的。
自从遇见那个人，他就不再普通了。
是那个人让他无法继续保持普通，所以，他没有错。
一切都是那个人——日高直美——的错。

[摘自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5799]NovelGame[/url]]
